methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected directly from each vendor's official pricing page (or, where the vendor page returned 403/JS-only or redirected to a non-pricing landing, from a reputable 2026 comparison source) on 2026-06-14, then adversarially re-verified against current 2026 sources. Outreach (outreach.ai) and Salesloft both confirmed quote-only models with no public per-seat figures — all tiers carry null monthlyUsd. Apollo.io's pricing page renders JS-only; current 2026 rates (Free/$0, Basic/$49, Professional/$79, Organization/$119 per user/mo annual) verified via CloudTalk's 2026 Apollo guide and corroborated by Warmly 2026 — Organization is a published self-serve tier. (An earlier draft used a March-2024 bardeen.ai guide that listed a stale $39 Basic and treated Organization as custom; corrected.) Reply.io's pricing page returned HTTP 403; Email Volume/$49 and Multichannel/$89 per user/mo are ANNUAL rates (Multichannel ~$99 monthly), verified via Amplemarket's 2026 cost guide — an earlier draft mislabeled these as month-to-month rates and was corrected. Groove was acquired by Clari (groove.co redirects to clari.com) and Clari publishes no self-serve pricing; included with null plans. Klenty (Starter $50/Growth $70/Plus $99 per user/mo annual), lemlist, and Yesware pricing fetched from official pages and confirmed. Woodpecker uses usage-based pricing at $4.80 per 100 contacted prospects/month with a free base tier; the included plan reflects an estimated ~$29/mo for 500 prospects on monthly billing (annual saves 33%). All telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null — this is a non-telephony vertical. monthlyUsd reflects the effective per-seat or flat monthly cost at the smallest billable unit on annual billing unless noted otherwise.
